name: Île Flottante
description: Pillowy poached meringue islands floating on crème anglaise, scattered with toasted almonds and caramel threads.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with unsalted butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg noodles and bay leaves until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the Gruyère cheese with the beef stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 15 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with parsley or a dusting of lemon zest.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: Bring your Gruyère cheese to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
